source.title: OCPP 2.0.1 Edition 4, December 2025, June 2026 errata, Appendices v1.5
source.interpretation: Part 3 JSON validation is a floor, not a substitute for Part 2 conditional fields and semantics. These assertions are independently authored source mappings, not a certification or execution report.

assertions.assertion: Use only native Accepted, Failed and VersionMismatch responses. A recommended fresh Full is not automatically sent after uncertainty.

Omitted Full contents clear entries but retain the submitted positive version. Omitted Differential contents retain entries and advance the version. Explicit empty arrays fail the pinned minItems 1 floor.

Native identifiers are ASCII a-z A-Z 0-9 * - _ = : + | @ . with length 0..36. Type and ASCII-case-insensitive identifier determine identity, not additionalInfo. Preserve original spelling. NoAuthorization requires an empty idToken. Generic additionalInfo.type and private message content remain UTF-8.
Only SendLocalList changes the list. Durable station list metadata survives recovery and ClearCache does not remove it. Invalid or failed updates never partially install.

Native message and storage limits are distinct. ItemsPerMessage and BytesPerMessage use actual variable values; Entries Actual is installed count, not capacity. Actual GetBaseReport/GetReport produce correlated native NotifyReport with Entries variableCharacteristics.maxLimit 256, separately from the changing Actual count. Component and variable metadata identities use Unicode default case folding, while instance/EVSE scopes never alias the root controller. Native token identifiers retain their separate ASCII primitive and identity rules.
Differential information present means upsert; absent means deletion. Full entries require idTokenInfo even though the JSON property is optional. An omitted entire Full list is still legal.
Update versions are positive i32. Differential versions no greater than installed return VersionMismatch. Full may replace with a lower positive version. Query values are nonnegative i32.
GetLocalListVersion returns 0 for disabled or uninitialized lists. A previously installed but emptied list retains its positive installed version; never translate OCPP 1.6 -1.
ClearCache applies only to AuthCache. Disabled cache or durable failure produces Rejected; no fake NotSupported response status. Cache and Local Authorization List remain independent.

Preserve native statuses, RFC3339 expiry with at most three fractional digits, EVSE scope, priority -9..9, BCP47 languages and private group/additional/custom/message metadata. Enabled list membership takes priority even if denied or expired, but does not prevent actual CSMS information from refreshing the separate cache. Deletion reveals the latest cached information. Metadata is inert.

Every EVSE ID in authorization information is a positive i32. Nonpositive IDs, including one invalid element among valid ones, reject Full/Differential atomically and cannot insert or refresh central-cache information. Part 3 integer shape alone is insufficient.

Cache latest native AuthorizeResponse and TransactionEventResponse information regardless of status or list membership. Accept new entries in a full cache by evicting an older received entry. Explicit expiry removes acceptance and expired entries. Optional AuthCacheCtrlr.LifeTime is unsupported and returns UnknownVariable; no default lifetime is invented. Cache and list enable flags are independent.

Current-socket Accepted Boot gates original persisted offline TransactionEvent delivery, preserving native transactionId, EVSE, seqNo, timestamp and typed token. Killed Sending recovers Uncertain and is never automatically retried as certain. Actual daemon restart does not replay CSMS mutating commands or fabricate native certainty.

execution_status: Native model, cache, process and fault tests and actual separate-process bridge/simulator smoke executed in isolated software verification; not hardware or OCA certification.
